output_primitives: score: ordered rubric probabilities and expected score

jev.input: text and JSON; image controls returned missing, so no verified image support
jev.weights: proprietary; no public weights identified in checked vendor documentation

luna.input: text, JSON, images; image-consumption controls passed using flat content parts in state
luna.weights: hosted OpenAI model; no public weights
luna.audio_video: OpenAI Decisions input contract excludes audio, files and tools; no native audio/video test performed

decider.input: text, JSON, images empirically verified; OpenRouter description says images unsupported but live color/OCR controls passed
decider.weights: Apache-2.0 release on Hugging Face; model card identifies Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune
decider.local_runtime: Vendor example: Python 3.12+, CUDA; approximately 49 GiB weights plus working memory. Local Decider not downloaded or run in this comparison.

integration_notes: Image URL is an inline base64 data URL inside state: [{type: text, text: ...}, {type: image_url, image_url: {url: data:image/png;base64,...}}].
User-message wrappers containing input_image or image_url parts were accepted with HTTP 200 but failed Luna image-consumption controls. Do not equate API acceptance with actual modality support.
The linked OpenRouter Multimodal Decisions guide at /docs/guides/community/multimodal-decisions returned 404 in both browser and fetch checks.
All modalities and context limits are route/version-specific. Advertised maximum context is not a tested maximum.
No native audio/video input was tested. Voice transcripts can be evaluated as text; screenshots or extracted frames can be evaluated as images on verified image routes.
